estimate_type: Fresh independent holdout estimates; independence requires external provenance
protocol_note: Fresh holdout was explicitly declared by the caller. Independence of new sources from training, tuning and prior evaluation must be established separately; it cannot be proved by this prediction CSV.

metric_conventions.primary_estimand: Image-weighted performance; each image has equal weight
metric_conventions.secondary_estimand: class_balanced_source_accuracy: mean image correctness per source, then equal-source mean within class, then equal-class mean over supplied classes; missing classes contribute zero. Not mean-probability multiview voting.
metric_conventions.source_group_labels: Class-pure source groups required; mixed true labels rejected
metric_conventions.macro: All ordered classes; undefined precision/recall/F1 set to zero
metric_conventions.balanced_accuracy: Mean recall of classes with positive true support
metric_conventions.brier_score: Mean sum of squared class probability errors; range [0, 2]
metric_conventions.log_loss: Natural logarithm; true probability clipped at float64 epsilon
metric_conventions.ece: Top-label confidence; equal-width bins [lower, upper), last includes 1
metric_conventions.undefined: JSON null; absent-class normalized confusion rows are zeros

bootstrap.method: class-stratified source-group cluster bootstrap, percentile 95% CI
bootstrap.estimand: Pooled image metrics: every image has equal weight; larger sources contribute more images. Secondary source_balanced_accuracy averages within-source image accuracy equally over sources; class_balanced_source_accuracy first averages sources within class, then averages all fixed classes. Neither is multiview voting.
bootstrap.macro_class_policy: Fixed classes in every draw; absent-class precision/recall/F1 and class-balanced source accuracy contribute zero. Balanced accuracy uses observed true classes only.
bootstrap.caveat: Approximate stratified-family bootstrap of fixed predictions when stratification is enabled. Keeps every image with its source draw multiplicity. Does NOT capture refitting, model-selection uncertainty, or dependent CV training sets. For fresh holdout, assumes independent new source groups; 21-35 groups yield limited uncertainty resolution. Singleton strata cannot estimate within-class source variation. Undefined replicates are omitted per metric; inspect n_valid. No fold stratification.

accuracy_threshold_assessment.note: A point estimate >=80% does not imply a 95% CI lower bound >=80%.

group_aggregated.aggregation: Arithmetic mean probabilities; one observation per source_group

bootstrap.method: class-stratified source-group cluster bootstrap, percentile 95% CI
bootstrap.estimand: One mean-probability classification per source; sources have equal weight.
